hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.php) case "$f" in */web/wp/*|*/vendor/*|*/web/app/plugins/*|*/web/app/themes/twentytwentyfive/*) exit 0;; esac; rel="${f#$PWD/}"; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . exec -T php vendor/bin/pint "$rel";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
